title: Emergency Fund
content: Aim for 3–6 months of essential expenses in a separate, accessible account. If you're a breadwinner or OFW with dependents, aim for 6–12 months. Use average monthly expenses (rent, utilities, food, minimum debt payments) as the basis. Keep it in a high-yield savings or time deposit—not in long-term investments—so you can access it quickly in a job loss or medical emergency.
